query:
SELECT 
  pc.id, pc.mes, pc.ano,
  (SELECT SUM(CAST(lc.valor AS DECIMAL(15,2))) FROM lancamento_custo lc WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = pc.id) as total_lancamento,
  (SELECT SUM(CAST(cs.total_geral AS DECIMAL(15,2))) FROM custo_setor cs WHERE cs.periodo_custo_id = pc.id) as total_custo_setor,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custo_setor cs WHERE cs.periodo_custo_id = pc.id) as qtd_custo_setor,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lancamento_custo lc WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = pc.id) as qtd_lancamento
FROM periodo_custo pc
WHERE (pc.mes IN (2,3,4) AND pc.ano = 2026)
ORDER BY pc.ano, pc.mes;
